title: Akiyama Mizuki — The Flavor You Deserve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - School Gate
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I decided to come to school after Toya told me that we have a test for English this afternoon...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But I'm so sleepy...
I was up so late last night working on stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, I've gotta take this test...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Plus, I can just go home once I'm done.
Although, Toya's not going to like that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's Li'l Bro. Is he having lunch by himself today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Toya usually has to do committee stuff during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... In that case...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What was that?! Aren't you happy to see me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, because you're always up to something.
Anyway, what do you want?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw you having lunch all alone, so I thought we could eat together♪ I actually just bought some bread a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, there's something I need to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember that exhibit your dad put on the other day? Did you go and visit?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I didn't.
I wasn't really that interested.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why do you know about that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Ena told us, and we ended up going as a group!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. She said she'd be helping out with it. I was really surprised when I heard that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Me too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, how's she been? Good?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno if that's the right word...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But Mom said that she seemed pretty relaxed after she came home with Dad. So I guess that means she's fine?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? In that case, I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty cool how your dad's a professional artist. I honestly couldn't believe it when I heard that for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really?
Yeah, I guess it's not a common profession...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's the furthest thing from common!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, he didn't ever teach you how to draw and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not really... But I do remember me and Ena trying to copy his paintings when we were little. Basically just coloring during playtime...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you and Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So she's been drawing since she was really little.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know much about her past, but I'm guessing she's wanted to be an artist for as long as she can remember.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, why'd you stop mid-sentence...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I didn't.
I was just surprised is all. I never knew that you and Ena used to draw together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Enough about that.
I ended up finding something else I wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that was singing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, Ena and Li'l Bro have a lot in common...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They both take what they do super seriously, and aren't afraid to take a hard look in the mirror...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even if they would deny it if someone pointed out their similarities.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's really cool how you guys are so passionate about what you do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You really love singing.
And I'm guessing Ena...has loved art for as long as she can remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... Based on her personality, I doubt she'd still be drawing if she didn't really love doing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Good point!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena really is amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No matter how hard things get or how much pain she has to endure, she just keeps going...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Nothing's ever stopped her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There isn't much I can do for her when it comes to her art and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But even so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want to be there for her when things get tough. I want to keep giving her all the support I can!)
